facts.business: Mayur Leather Products Limited is a company that has not generated any revenue from operations or carried out manufacturing activities during the current and previous financial year, and is expanding into consultancy, advisory, legal and management support services, recruitment and staffing solutions, BPO, KPO, LPO, IT-enabled services, training and other allied professional services.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided text
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern: The company has not generated any revenue from operations during the current and previous financial year, no manufacturing activities carried out, accumulated losses of Rs. 616.41 lakhs as at March 31, 2026. Emphasis of Matter: Holding company transferred Rs. 213.60 lakhs to subsidiary towards provisional adjustment for sale of land by Canara Bank due to loan default in 2022-23; subsidiary's land sold for Rs. 226 lakhs in August 2024; matter challenged before Debt Recovery Tribunal and pending adjudication; final settlement pending as on reporting date.

key_risks: Material uncertainty related to going concern due to no revenue from operations, no manufacturing activities, and accumulated losses of Rs. 616.41 lakhs
Adverse audit opinion on standalone financial statements
Pending litigation regarding land sale by Canara Bank and subsequent sale of subsidiary's land, challenged before Debt Recovery Tribunal
Dependence on promoter fund infusion and improvement in operations for going concern assumption
facts.related_party_note: Holding company transferred Rs. 213.60 lakhs to subsidiary Mayur Global Private Limited towards provisional adjustment in respect of sale of land executed by Canara Bank due to holding company's default in repayment of loan obligations during 2022-23. Consequential sale of subsidiary's land for Rs. 226 lakhs (approx.) in August 2024. Matter challenged before Debt Recovery Tribunal, pending adjudication. Final settlement between company and subsidiary pending as on reporting date.
